jobs.title: Veteran Treatment Therapists/Social Workers
jobs.description:
Behavioral Health is seeking Clinicians who have experience treating veterans and military personnel.

Experience in treating those with PTSD, depression and addictions resulting from military operations.

Clinicians from Davis-Monthan AFB and Fort Huachuca are encouraged to apply.

Purpose Statement

Diagnose and treat mental and emotional disorders, whether cognitive, affective or behavioral.

Essential Functions

Apply psychotherapeutic techniques and interventions in the delivery of services to individuals and families for the purpose of treating such diagnosed emotional and behavioral health disorders.
Conduct psychosocial assessment and develop an initial discharge plan.
Conduct individual, group or family sessions as appropriate for the treatment plan of the patient.
Provide initial treatment planning for patient based on assessment and coordinate any additional services needed and revise as necessary.
Maintain documentation of therapy services provided to each patient, according to facility and professional standards and revise as needed.
Maintain a caseload as assigned.
Participate in treatment team meetings and collaborate with other staff to facilitate services for the patient as appropriate to their treatment plan.
May provide these services in an inpatient or outpatient setting.
Provide case management, discharge planning or after-care planning according to treatment plan.
May assist in educating and training staff on behavior management or therapeutic crisis intervention.
May coordinate various clinical and psychosocial or educational activities with patient and their families.
Demonstrate a positive, empathetic and professional attitude towards customers always. When patient needs are not met, acknowledge and work to resolve complaints. Recognize that patient safety is a top priority.

Other Functions

Perform other functions and tasks as assigned.

Licenses/Designations/Certifications

State or national licensure for professional therapy providers required.
CPR and de-escalation/restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
First aid may be required based on state or facility.

Education/Experience/Skill Requirements

Master's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Counseling or other recognized therapeutic field required.
Two or more years’ experience as a therapist with one or more years’ experience with the specific population of the facility required.

Are you passionate about creating opportunities for Aboriginal people to thrive?

Do you enjoy leading a team, building relationships and helping people reach their goals?

As our Program Coordinator, you’ll lead our Workplace Mentoring Program, supporting Aboriginal young people across the Central Coast to explore education, training and employment opportunities.

You’ll connect with mentors, employers, schools and training providers to create pathways that empower participants and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Every day, you’ll have the chance to inspire others, strengthen community connections and create lasting change.

You’re a natural relationship builder who enjoys helping people and programs succeed. You’ll have experience coordinating community, mentoring or case management programs, with the confidence to lead a small team and build strong stakeholder relationships.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Position Details

Position Information

Banner Position Number R10940 Position Title Program Manager Classification Title MURC-Managers, All Other Department SOM - VP Health Science/Dean - RC5000 Job Description

Position Overview

The Program Manager leads the planning, implementation, and day-to-day operations of clinical, research, and community health projects at Marshall University and Marshall Health. The portfolio may include initiatives addressing diabetes, obesity, cardiometabolic disease, and other health priorities through clinical services, research studies, education, digital health, or community-based interventions.

Working with program leaders, investigators, and clinical teams, the manager translates approved project plans into coordinated activities across participating sites, institutional departments, and external partners. The role oversees schedules, operational readiness, resources, budgets, deliverables, reporting, and continuous improvement across one or more projects. Clinical decisions and scientific oversight remain with the designated clinical and research leads.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Project Planning and Operational Management

Develop and maintain project plans that define scope, objectives, tasks, accountable leads, milestones, dependencies, and deadlines. Coordinate activities from project initiation and launch through implementation, evaluation, transition, and closeout.
Manage competing priorities across projects, identify shared resource needs, and resolve scheduling or capacity conflicts with leadership. Track changes to scope, timelines, and resources through established approval processes.
Coordinate launch readiness, including staffing, training, facilities, equipment, systems, approvals, and documentation appropriate to each project.
Maintain standard operating procedures, implementation tools, meeting records, and decision logs. Track risks and issues, assign owners and mitigation actions, and escalate barriers that threaten safety, quality, budgets, or delivery.

Team and Partner Coordination

Serve as the operational liaison among clinical and research teams, participating sites, institutional departments, community organizations, sponsors, and other partners.
Clarify responsibilities, coordinate work across disciplines, monitor agreed deliverables, and address operational barriers. Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and workload planning for project staff as assigned.
Organize project meetings, document decisions, and follow up on action items. Develop orientation materials and training resources with subject-matter experts to support consistent implementation.

Clinical and Research Project Delivery

Coordinate project-specific workflows for outreach, referral, recruitment, enrollment, consent documentation, service delivery, data collection, and follow-up, as applicable.
Support implementation of approved clinical pathways, study protocols, and evaluation plans. Coordinate required institutional and regulatory submissions with investigators and designated compliance teams, and track approvals, renewals, and training.
Monitor participation, engagement, retention, and completion where relevant. Work with clinical, research, and community teams to address access barriers and improve the patient or participant experience.
Escalate safety concerns, protocol deviations, and unresolved service or communication gaps to the responsible clinical or research lead. Track operational follow-up and corrective actions through resolution.

Resources and Technology

Coordinate purchasing, equipment and supply needs, vendor deliverables, service agreements, and technical support with the relevant institutional teams.
Support implementation and testing of project systems, including data-collection platforms, electronic health record workflows, or digital health tools where applicable. Coordinate user training and contingency procedures.
Work with legal, privacy, security, and data teams to establish appropriate agreements, access permissions, secure information exchange, and records management.

Performance Reporting and Quality Improvement

Work with analysts, investigators, and program leads to define project measures, maintain dashboards, and track progress against milestones, deliverables, and intended outcomes.
Prepare accurate progress reports, presentations, and supporting documentation for leadership, sponsors, funders, and institutional stakeholders according to project requirements and deadlines.
Identify performance gaps, coordinate reviews of their causes, assign improvement actions, and assess results. Communicate data limitations, delivery risks, and decisions requiring leadership input.
Support evaluation, dissemination of findings, and preparation of project reports, presentations, manuscripts, or funding proposals in collaboration with the responsible teams.

Budget and Funding Management

Develop and monitor project budgets with program leads, finance, and grants administration. Track expenditures, commitments, invoices, staffing allocations, and variances; maintain documentation for review and audit.
Coordinate compliance with funding terms and institutional financial procedures, including required reports and approved budget changes. Ensure costs are allocated appropriately across projects and funding sources, with no duplicate charging.
Support sustainability planning, resource forecasting, and future funding opportunities. Coordinate project closeout, transfer of ongoing activities, and documentation of lessons learned for subsequent projects.

Location MURC - Marshall University Research Corporation Salary Range Salary is commensurate with education, experience, and internal equity

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, public health, business administration, nursing, health sciences, or a related field.

Experience

At least five years of progressively responsible experience in program management, healthcare operations, clinical research, public health, or a related area, including at least two years leading projects or multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage project plans, budgets, deliverables, risks, and partner relationships, and to coordinate multiple priorities and deadlines.
Experience with performance reporting, project documentation, and budget tracking in a healthcare, research, academic, or public health setting.
Strong communication, organization, facilitation, and problem-solving skills; ability to interpret performance data and collaborate effectively with clinical, research, administrative, and community partners.
Proficiency with project-management tools, spreadsheets, presentations, and collaborative systems; knowledge of confidentiality, secure data handling, and applicable institutional procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

Education

Master’s degree in a relevant field; Project Management Professional (PMP) or comparable certification.

Experience

Experience with grant-funded programs, clinical research, quality improvement, or implementation of new clinical or community services.
Experience in diabetes, obesity, cardiometabolic disease, digital health, or rural and underserved populations; familiarity with research oversight, healthcare reimbursement, or sustainability planning.

jobs.location: Bergen op Zoom, North Brabant, Netherlands
jobs.description:
Werken in Moermont

Residentie Moermont is de grootste locatie van tanteLouise. Een veelzijdige woonzorglocatie waar verschillende doelgroepen samenkomen: van psychogeriatrie (PG) en somatiek tot niet-aangeboren hersenletsel (NAH), gerontopsychiatrie en bewoners met onbegrepen gedrag. Daarnaast is er een cultuurspecifieke Indische woning en een woning voor herstelgerichte zorg. Die diversiteit zorgt voor veel kennis en expertise onder één dak. Binnen Moermont is aandacht voor zorg én welzijn, begeleiding, wonen en kwaliteit van leven. Professioneel samenwerken, korte lijnen en oog voor de mens achter de zorgvraag zijn daarbij belangrijk.

Je komt te werken op de PG-toren, waar ouderen met dementie wonen. Op iedere etage zijn drie woningen met in totaal ongeveer 18 bewoners. Door deze kleinschalige opzet kennen bewoners, familieleden en collega’s elkaar goed en ontstaat er ruimte voor persoonlijke aandacht. Iedere bewoner heeft een eigen levensverhaal, gewoontes en behoeften. We kijken daarom naar wat iemand nodig heeft om zich veilig, prettig en zoveel mogelijk zichzelf te voelen.

Binnen de PG-toren werk je samen met collega’s vanuit verschillende disciplines. Je deelt kennis, stemt af en kijkt samen wat een bewoner en zijn of haar naasten nodig hebben. Affiniteit met ouderen met dementie is voor deze functie dan ook een must.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Social Worker ben jij een vertrouwd gezicht voor onze bewoners. Je ondersteunt hen bij het behouden van hun zelfstandigheid, sociale contacten en kwaliteit van leven. Je voert gesprekken, signaleert wat iemand nodig heeft en stimuleert bewoners om actief mee te doen aan het dagelijks leven.

Samen met collega's, familie en andere betrokkenen zorg je voor een omgeving waarin bewoners zich gezien, gehoord en thuis voelen. Je organiseert en begeleidt activiteiten, onderhoudt contact met naasten en draagt bij aan het welzijn van bewoners.

Daarnaast ondersteun je waar nodig in de dagelijkse zorg, bijvoorbeeld tijdens de ochtendzorg of op drukke momenten. Hiervoor volg je een ADL-scholing. Zo ben je zichtbaar op de afdeling en maak je écht onderdeel uit van het team.

Je hebt een sterke focus op het welzijn van onze bewoners. Jij:

Denkt samen met de HBO-V’ers mee over hoe we het welzijn van bewoners verder kunnen versterken.
Signaleert bijzonderheden en stem je deze af met collega's en andere disciplines.
Levert een bijdrage aan een veilige, prettige en huiselijke leefomgeving.
Werkt nauw samen met zorg-, welzijns- en behandelcollega's.
Draagt bij aan de verbinding tussen bewoners, naasten en medewerkers.
Helpt mee om nieuwe initiatieven en activiteiten vorm te geven die bijdragen aan het welzijn van de bewoners en ervaringsgerichte zorg.

Je werkt in wisselende dag-, avond- en weekenddiensten (ook tijdens feestdagen), zodat je aanwezig bent op de momenten waarop bewoners jouw ondersteuning het meest nodig hebben.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een warm hart voor ouderen en vindt het leuk om bewoners te ondersteunen bij een betekenisvolle dag. Je maakt makkelijk contact, luistert goed en ziet wat iemand nodig heeft. Daarbij werk je graag samen met collega's en naasten en voel je je verantwoordelijk voor een fijne woon- en leefomgeving.

Daarnaast beschik je over een afgeronde mbo niveau 4-opleiding Social Work, Maatschappelijke Zorg of Persoonlijk Begeleider Specifieke Doelgroepen. Je bent flexibel inzetbaar, denkt in mogelijkheden en bent bereid ook een rol te spelen in de dagelijkse zorg. Hiervoor volg je een ADL-scholing als je deze nog niet hebt.

Wat bieden we je?

Wat bieden we je?

Salaris conform de cao VVT in FWG 45 (€4.245,84 bruto per maand o.b.v. 36 uur per week) op basis van jouw werkervaring), 8% vakantiegeld, reiskostenvergoeding en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering in november.
Het aantal uur dat je gaat werken bespreken we samen.
TanteLouise investeert maximaal in de ontwikkeling van haar eigen medewerkers. Zo is er ruimte om opleidingen of cursussen te volgen en heeft tante haar eigen academie waarmee jij aan de slag kunt!
Tantes extra's: je kunt jouw (bovenwettelijke) verlof- of plusuren inzetten voor het aanschaffen van bijv. een nieuwe wasmachine of fiets via financieel voordeel. Ook geeft tante elk jaar een groots personeelsfeest en ontvang je gedurende het jaar verschillende presentjes waarmee we jou in het zonnetje zetten!
Goed om te weten: als je bij ons komt werken, is het verplicht om een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) aan te leveren. De kosten daarvan vergoeden wij!

Word jij onze nieuwe collega?

Leuk! Stuur ons een brief met je CV en motivatie! Vergeet niet om je motivatie toe te voegen, dat is een belangrijk onderdeel van de selectieprocedure. Heb je nog vragen? Neem dan contact op met een van onze leidinggevenden via contactinformatie .

Are you ready to make an impact at one of London’s leading Further Education providers? Capital City College is looking for a skilled Kings Trust Assistant Team Leader to support and drive key operational functions, helping shape the future of education in the heart of London.

SSGC (Sui Southern Gas Company) is a leading energy utility responsible for the transmission and distribution of natural gas across southern Pakistan, including the province of Sindh. The HSEQ Supervisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Sindh, Pakistan, responsible for supervising health, safety, environment, and quality activities across assigned operations. Strong communication and report-writing skills, with the ability to train and influence diverse teams.
Experience in the energy, utilities, or industrial sector and familiarity with local HSEQ regulations in Pakistan are an advantage.
Ability to work on-site in field conditions, manage multiple priorities, and use basic computer applications for documentation and reporting.

new_jobs.description:
Position Details

Position Information

Banner Position Number R10940 Position Title Program Manager Classification Title MURC-Managers, All Other Department SOM - VP Health Science/Dean - RC5000 Job Description

Position Overview

The Program Manager leads the planning, implementation, and day-to-day operations of clinical, research, and community health projects at Marshall University and Marshall Health. The portfolio may include initiatives addressing diabetes, obesity, cardiometabolic disease, and other health priorities through clinical services, research studies, education, digital health, or community-based interventions.

Working with program leaders, investigators, and clinical teams, the manager translates approved project plans into coordinated activities across participating sites, institutional departments, and external partners. The role oversees schedules, operational readiness, resources, budgets, deliverables, reporting, and continuous improvement across one or more projects. Clinical decisions and scientific oversight remain with the designated clinical and research leads.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Project Planning and Operational Management

Develop and maintain project plans that define scope, objectives, tasks, accountable leads, milestones, dependencies, and deadlines. Coordinate activities from project initiation and launch through implementation, evaluation, transition, and closeout.
Manage competing priorities across projects, identify shared resource needs, and resolve scheduling or capacity conflicts with leadership. Track changes to scope, timelines, and resources through established approval processes.
Coordinate launch readiness, including staffing, training, facilities, equipment, systems, approvals, and documentation appropriate to each project.
Maintain standard operating procedures, implementation tools, meeting records, and decision logs. Track risks and issues, assign owners and mitigation actions, and escalate barriers that threaten safety, quality, budgets, or delivery.

Team and Partner Coordination

Serve as the operational liaison among clinical and research teams, participating sites, institutional departments, community organizations, sponsors, and other partners.
Clarify responsibilities, coordinate work across disciplines, monitor agreed deliverables, and address operational barriers. Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and workload planning for project staff as assigned.
Organize project meetings, document decisions, and follow up on action items. Develop orientation materials and training resources with subject-matter experts to support consistent implementation.

Clinical and Research Project Delivery

Coordinate project-specific workflows for outreach, referral, recruitment, enrollment, consent documentation, service delivery, data collection, and follow-up, as applicable.
Support implementation of approved clinical pathways, study protocols, and evaluation plans. Coordinate required institutional and regulatory submissions with investigators and designated compliance teams, and track approvals, renewals, and training.
Monitor participation, engagement, retention, and completion where relevant. Work with clinical, research, and community teams to address access barriers and improve the patient or participant experience.
Escalate safety concerns, protocol deviations, and unresolved service or communication gaps to the responsible clinical or research lead. Track operational follow-up and corrective actions through resolution.

Resources and Technology

Coordinate purchasing, equipment and supply needs, vendor deliverables, service agreements, and technical support with the relevant institutional teams.
Support implementation and testing of project systems, including data-collection platforms, electronic health record workflows, or digital health tools where applicable. Coordinate user training and contingency procedures.
Work with legal, privacy, security, and data teams to establish appropriate agreements, access permissions, secure information exchange, and records management.

Performance Reporting and Quality Improvement

Work with analysts, investigators, and program leads to define project measures, maintain dashboards, and track progress against milestones, deliverables, and intended outcomes.
Prepare accurate progress reports, presentations, and supporting documentation for leadership, sponsors, funders, and institutional stakeholders according to project requirements and deadlines.
Identify performance gaps, coordinate reviews of their causes, assign improvement actions, and assess results. Communicate data limitations, delivery risks, and decisions requiring leadership input.
Support evaluation, dissemination of findings, and preparation of project reports, presentations, manuscripts, or funding proposals in collaboration with the responsible teams.

Budget and Funding Management

Develop and monitor project budgets with program leads, finance, and grants administration. Track expenditures, commitments, invoices, staffing allocations, and variances; maintain documentation for review and audit.
Coordinate compliance with funding terms and institutional financial procedures, including required reports and approved budget changes. Ensure costs are allocated appropriately across projects and funding sources, with no duplicate charging.
Support sustainability planning, resource forecasting, and future funding opportunities. Coordinate project closeout, transfer of ongoing activities, and documentation of lessons learned for subsequent projects.

Location MURC - Marshall University Research Corporation Salary Range Salary is commensurate with education, experience, and internal equity

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, public health, business administration, nursing, health sciences, or a related field.

Experience

At least five years of progressively responsible experience in program management, healthcare operations, clinical research, public health, or a related area, including at least two years leading projects or multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage project plans, budgets, deliverables, risks, and partner relationships, and to coordinate multiple priorities and deadlines.
Experience with performance reporting, project documentation, and budget tracking in a healthcare, research, academic, or public health setting.
Strong communication, organization, facilitation, and problem-solving skills; ability to interpret performance data and collaborate effectively with clinical, research, administrative, and community partners.
Proficiency with project-management tools, spreadsheets, presentations, and collaborative systems; knowledge of confidentiality, secure data handling, and applicable institutional procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

Education

Master’s degree in a relevant field; Project Management Professional (PMP) or comparable certification.

Experience

Experience with grant-funded programs, clinical research, quality improvement, or implementation of new clinical or community services.
Experience in diabetes, obesity, cardiometabolic disease, digital health, or rural and underserved populations; familiarity with research oversight, healthcare reimbursement, or sustainability planning.

new_jobs.title: Social Worker niveau 4
new_jobs.location: Bergen op Zoom, North Brabant, Netherlands
new_jobs.description:
Werken in Moermont

Residentie Moermont is de grootste locatie van tanteLouise. Een veelzijdige woonzorglocatie waar verschillende doelgroepen samenkomen: van psychogeriatrie (PG) en somatiek tot niet-aangeboren hersenletsel (NAH), gerontopsychiatrie en bewoners met onbegrepen gedrag. Daarnaast is er een cultuurspecifieke Indische woning en een woning voor herstelgerichte zorg. Die diversiteit zorgt voor veel kennis en expertise onder één dak. Binnen Moermont is aandacht voor zorg én welzijn, begeleiding, wonen en kwaliteit van leven. Professioneel samenwerken, korte lijnen en oog voor de mens achter de zorgvraag zijn daarbij belangrijk.

Je komt te werken op de PG-toren, waar ouderen met dementie wonen. Op iedere etage zijn drie woningen met in totaal ongeveer 18 bewoners. Door deze kleinschalige opzet kennen bewoners, familieleden en collega’s elkaar goed en ontstaat er ruimte voor persoonlijke aandacht. Iedere bewoner heeft een eigen levensverhaal, gewoontes en behoeften. We kijken daarom naar wat iemand nodig heeft om zich veilig, prettig en zoveel mogelijk zichzelf te voelen.

Binnen de PG-toren werk je samen met collega’s vanuit verschillende disciplines. Je deelt kennis, stemt af en kijkt samen wat een bewoner en zijn of haar naasten nodig hebben. Affiniteit met ouderen met dementie is voor deze functie dan ook een must.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Social Worker ben jij een vertrouwd gezicht voor onze bewoners. Je ondersteunt hen bij het behouden van hun zelfstandigheid, sociale contacten en kwaliteit van leven. Je voert gesprekken, signaleert wat iemand nodig heeft en stimuleert bewoners om actief mee te doen aan het dagelijks leven.

Samen met collega's, familie en andere betrokkenen zorg je voor een omgeving waarin bewoners zich gezien, gehoord en thuis voelen. Je organiseert en begeleidt activiteiten, onderhoudt contact met naasten en draagt bij aan het welzijn van bewoners.

Daarnaast ondersteun je waar nodig in de dagelijkse zorg, bijvoorbeeld tijdens de ochtendzorg of op drukke momenten. Hiervoor volg je een ADL-scholing. Zo ben je zichtbaar op de afdeling en maak je écht onderdeel uit van het team.

Je hebt een sterke focus op het welzijn van onze bewoners. Jij:

Denkt samen met de HBO-V’ers mee over hoe we het welzijn van bewoners verder kunnen versterken.
Signaleert bijzonderheden en stem je deze af met collega's en andere disciplines.
Levert een bijdrage aan een veilige, prettige en huiselijke leefomgeving.
Werkt nauw samen met zorg-, welzijns- en behandelcollega's.
Draagt bij aan de verbinding tussen bewoners, naasten en medewerkers.
Helpt mee om nieuwe initiatieven en activiteiten vorm te geven die bijdragen aan het welzijn van de bewoners en ervaringsgerichte zorg.

Je werkt in wisselende dag-, avond- en weekenddiensten (ook tijdens feestdagen), zodat je aanwezig bent op de momenten waarop bewoners jouw ondersteuning het meest nodig hebben.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een warm hart voor ouderen en vindt het leuk om bewoners te ondersteunen bij een betekenisvolle dag. Je maakt makkelijk contact, luistert goed en ziet wat iemand nodig heeft. Daarbij werk je graag samen met collega's en naasten en voel je je verantwoordelijk voor een fijne woon- en leefomgeving.

Daarnaast beschik je over een afgeronde mbo niveau 4-opleiding Social Work, Maatschappelijke Zorg of Persoonlijk Begeleider Specifieke Doelgroepen. Je bent flexibel inzetbaar, denkt in mogelijkheden en bent bereid ook een rol te spelen in de dagelijkse zorg. Hiervoor volg je een ADL-scholing als je deze nog niet hebt.

Wat bieden we je?

Wat bieden we je?

Salaris conform de cao VVT in FWG 45 (€4.245,84 bruto per maand o.b.v. 36 uur per week) op basis van jouw werkervaring), 8% vakantiegeld, reiskostenvergoeding en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering in november.
Het aantal uur dat je gaat werken bespreken we samen.
TanteLouise investeert maximaal in de ontwikkeling van haar eigen medewerkers. Zo is er ruimte om opleidingen of cursussen te volgen en heeft tante haar eigen academie waarmee jij aan de slag kunt!
Tantes extra's: je kunt jouw (bovenwettelijke) verlof- of plusuren inzetten voor het aanschaffen van bijv. een nieuwe wasmachine of fiets via financieel voordeel. Ook geeft tante elk jaar een groots personeelsfeest en ontvang je gedurende het jaar verschillende presentjes waarmee we jou in het zonnetje zetten!
Goed om te weten: als je bij ons komt werken, is het verplicht om een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) aan te leveren. De kosten daarvan vergoeden wij!

Word jij onze nieuwe collega?

Leuk! Stuur ons een brief met je CV en motivatie! Vergeet niet om je motivatie toe te voegen, dat is een belangrijk onderdeel van de selectieprocedure. Heb je nog vragen? Neem dan contact op met een van onze leidinggevenden via contactinformatie .

new_jobs.title: King's Trust Assistant Team Leader
new_jobs.description:
Make a Meaningful Impact Behind the Scenes at Capital City College

Are you ready to make an impact at one of London’s leading Further Education providers? Capital City College is looking for a skilled Kings Trust Assistant Team Leader to support and drive key operational functions, helping shape the future of education in the heart of London.

About The Role

This role is offered on a fixed-term, full-time basis, the contract will end on 31st of July 2027. This role is full-time, working 35 hours per week.

The Assistant Team Leader supports the successful delivery of The King’s Trust Team Programme at Capital City College, helping young people aged 16–25 to build confidence, motivation and skills to progress into employment, education, training or volunteering. Working closely with the Team Leader, the postholder contributes to the recruitment, planning, delivery and evaluation of the 12-week programme, while providing pastoral support and encouragement to participants.

About The Team

You will join a friendly, professional team committed to delivering high-quality support across the college. Working together, you’ll help create a positive and inclusive environment where everyone feels valued.

You will be joining a dynamic and supportive team of colleagues.who are committed to excellence. The team has a strong collaborative culture, sharing best practice and innovative approaches.

About You

We’re looking for a reliable and motivated individual who takes pride in delivering excellent service. You should bring:

Assist the Team Leader in developing and delivering a recruitment strategy to attract a diverse group of young people (16–25).Liaise with referral partners including Job Centres, Connexions, youth services, schools, employers and community organisations.Assist in delivering The King’s Trust Employment, Teamwork and Community Skills (ETCS) qualification from Entry Level 3 to Level 2.Support the organisation of purposeful enrichment activities such as guest speakers, day visits and residential experiences.Identify and report additional needs (e.g. literacy, numeracy, digital skills, or pastoral support) and contribute to individual learning plans.Support the facilitation of learner reviews, evaluations and assessments to monitor progress and encourage achievement.Assist with administrative duties including 1:1s, target setting, tracking portfolio progress and gathering assessment evidence.Contribute to the completion of reports and statistical returns for Capital City College and The King’s Trust.Participate in placement visits to ensure health, safety, and quality of experience.Help coordinate guest speakers and employer engagement to broaden learners’ opportunities.

About Us

Capital City College (CCC),one of the UK’s largest FE colleges in London. This influential group supports over35,000 studentsbased across 12 London campusesannually to develop the skills and knowledge to advance their career prospects or progress into higher education. This is done by an unrelenting commitment to curriculum innovation and an obsession with the quality of the student experience, which is underpinned by a resilient and prudent approach to financial management. Capital City College are widely recognised for their commitment to diversity, inclusivity, and educational excellence, positively impacting the lives of students across the capital and beyond.

Why Join Capital City College?

Benefits

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a passionate, purpose-driven team that puts learners first. At CCC, we value the dedication of our staff and offer a comprehensive benefits package including:

Membership of the Local Government Pension SchemeAccess to TELLUS – our discount and wellbeing platformParticipation in the Cycle to Work schemeInterest-free season ticket loans for public transportAnnual eye tests and contributions towards spectaclesFlu vaccinations and access to occupational health servicesMedicash health plans – including cashback on everyday medical expenses and wellbeing tools for you and your familyGenerous annual leave entitlement, including one Relaxation Day per yearFive Continuous Professional Development (CPD) days which can be used for your professional developmentOur Commitment to Equality and Safeguarding

We are proud to be a diverse and inclusive organisation. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are committed to creating a safe and respectful working environment for everyone.

CCC is committed to the safeguarding of young people and vulnerable adults. All roles require the successful candidate to undergo a DBS check — with some positions requiring an Enhanced Disclosure.

Our Values

To create a future that’s uniquely yours.

As the largest further and higher education college in London, we offer the quality you deserve, state of the art facilities and a wide range of courses as unique as your interests and aptitude. Through partnerships with industry and academia, we open doors to your real-world success.

Studying at our campuses isn’t just about good grades. It’s being part of a community within a community, that reflects the diversity and vibrancy of London itself. Where every background and perspective are celebrated, and everyone feels they belong.

As teachers and staff, we’re all driven by you –getting to know you, helping you feel valued and giving you hands-on support every step of the way. Whether you’re a creative spirit, a tech whiz, or a business mastermind, together we’ll create a future that’s uniquely yours.

Real-life learning

Practical and personal, we provide valuable skills and knowledge that you can apply in the real world.

Connected community

Welcoming and open-minded, we create a community of people and businesses where you feel valued, supported, and confident to grow.

Expanded horizons

Innovating and inspiring, we help you become and achieve more than you thought was possible.

Apply now for the Kings Trust Assistant Team Leader role if you're ready to contribute to the success of a dynamic education environment and make a real difference.

new_jobs.title: HSEQ Supervisor
new_jobs.description:
Company Description
SSGC (Sui Southern Gas Company) is a leading energy utility responsible for the transmission and distribution of natural gas across southern Pakistan, including the province of Sindh. The company plays a critical role in supporting industrial, commercial, and residential energy needs. SSGC places strong emphasis on reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance in its operations. Team members contribute to essential infrastructure that supports economic growth and community well-being.
Role Description
The HSEQ Supervisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Sindh, Pakistan, responsible for supervising health, safety, environment, and quality activities across assigned operations. The role includes conducting regular site inspections, identifying hazards, and ensuring compliance with company policies, legal requirements, and industry standards. The HSEQ Supervisor will lead and document accident and incident investigations, prepare reports, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Day-to-day tasks involve coordinating occupational health initiatives, delivering and supporting safety training, monitoring environmental and safety performance indicators, and collaborating with operational teams to promote a strong HSEQ culture. The position also involves maintaining accurate HSEQ records, supporting audits, and continuously improving procedures to reduce risk and enhance safe working practices.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Health & Safety and Occupational Health skills, with experience implementing safe work practices and managing workplace risks.
Candidates should possess Environment Health and Safety (EHS) skills, including knowledge of environmental regulations, pollution prevention, and sustainable operational practices.
Candidates should possess Accident Investigation skills, including root cause analysis, reporting, and development of corrective and preventive actions.
Candidates should possess Inspection skills, including conducting site inspections, safety audits, and compliance checks with documented findings.
Relevant professional certifications in HSE/EHS (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH or equivalent) are highly beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Occupational Health, or a related field is preferred.
Strong communication and report-writing skills, with the ability to train and influence diverse teams.
Experience in the energy, utilities, or industrial sector and familiarity with local HSEQ regulations in Pakistan are an advantage.
Ability to work on-site in field conditions, manage multiple priorities, and use basic computer applications for documentation and reporting.

This position involves providing specialized nursing care to patients at the end of life, supporting their physical, psychosocial, emotional, and spiritual needs. The nurse will evaluate patient conditions, develop and implement individualized care plans, and coordinate care with an interprofessional team, patients, and families. The role requires evaluating changes in patient status, updating care plans, and practicing evidence-based care to achieve quality outcomes.

Nursing Diploma/Associate's Degree in Nursing (RN license required)
Minimum of 2 years of nursing experience; experience in home health or hospice preferred
Valid Driver's License and ability to provide coverage in all regions during on-call
Strong assessment, communication, critical thinking, and collaborative skills
Preferred: Bachelor's Degree in Nursing or related field, 2-5 years of experience

Key Duties

Assess patient needs, values, and barriers to care
Develop, implement, and document personalized care plans
Collaborate with the healthcare team and families to promote holistic care
Monitor patient condition changes and update care strategies accordingly
Ensure safe, compassionate, and culturally sensitive care delivery
